description: turbo-tasks-backend SnapshotCoordinator: count active operations in cache-line-padded per-thread stripes instead of one shared AtomicUsize that every operation's begin and end write (only while the persistent cache is on); the snapshot flags move to their own read-mostly word, a phase closes admission by setting the running bit and then summing the stripes (SeqCst store-load handshake), reopening it if an operation was counted, and an operation end takes the mutex to notify a waiting phase only when its stripe empties and the stripes sum to zero
